title: Critical tribes influence bound
statement: For a natural number $w>0$, let $s_w$ be the largest natural number $s\le 2^{w+2}$ such that $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le\tfrac12$, and take the tribes function with $s_w$ blocks of width $w$. For every set $J$ of coordinates in its dimension $s_ww$, its coalitional influence is at most $\tfrac12+(|J|+1)2^{-w}$.
